title: Default recursive test discovery is not a native filesystem operation
observed_need: Find independent manifests across a repository while keeping discovery deterministic and inspectable.
current_language_behavior: MNCS does not currently expose portable recursive directory enumeration to an external consumer.
why_insufficient: A magical host-side recursive scan would hide package boundaries and make test selection depend on filesystem order.
minimal_reproducer: tools/mncs_test.py: discover_manifests(root, recursive=True) uses sorted os.walk/rglob only when explicitly requested.
desired_direction: A package/module-aware native discovery contract, or a bounded standard-library directory enumeration API with stable ordering and capability grants.
workaround: The normal run path requires an explicit root manifest and direct tests/*.toml entries; recursive discovery is opt-in and sorted.
